== Queen's Guards or Queen's Guard? ==

If you look in the back of TOM in the glossary, it lists the entry as "Queen's Guards" then promptly follows with a description using '''Queen's Guard''' twice as often as '''Queens Guards.'''  It is rare to see an organization call itself XYZ Guards, but not impossible (Think of <u>''National Guard''</u>, here in the US as an example).

I've actually looked in TOM for usage in the prose and cannot find any, but if I could see how RJ or BrS uses  it, that would go a long way to resolving how this title should be stated, IMHO.[[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 00:21, February 20, 2012 (UTC)

:It is actually used both ways in the novels, with Queen's Guards about twice as more used as Queen's Guard. I think this is a rare instance when you can use either one to fit into what you're writing and not have to fit your writing around the title. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 02:39, February 20, 2012 (UTC)
